summary: Host only: nothing was built for, flashed to, run on or read from the phone, and no decision was requested. The 16 SIMD/FP instruction forms in the direct-call closure of cpu_data_init and PE_init_platform(0, boot_args) were implemented in a subclass of the NAT-030 interpreter (kstart_sim.py and after5.py unchanged, hashes equal to the NAT-032 record) and each of the 86 distinct instruction words was compared with Unicorn on random and edge inputs (x registers, SP, Q registers, a 128 KiB buffer, PC); a deliberately wrong cmhi makes the comparison fail while the correct one passes. With them the real payload kernel runs in the model from the entry to the C checkpoint 11 stop (reference, slot[2] = 11: 9411 steps) and, after a stop at assembly checkpoint 5 and the NAT-032 resume (slot[2] = 11, MMU-off branch to site5 - 28, x0..x3 and x9..x11 clobbered): 9433 steps, arriving with identical x registers, vector registers, system registers and RAM and no taint violation. Arrival at the stub: x0 = loader_log PA 0x9e1f90a00, x1 = 0, x2 = 2, x3 = 11, MMU on, TTBR0 = loader_jump's private table 0x9e2279000, TTBR1 0x9e15af000, VBAR 0xfffffff007437000, SCTLR 0x3454593d, CPACR 0x300000 (written by the kernel before any SIMD instruction), loader_return_entered = 1, loader_log length 0. The executed path is 67 function entries, 23 distinct functions, no panic function, no ml_io_map/pmap_map/psci/redwood call and (the model raises external-abort for any PA outside the RAM window) no MMIO access; 39 SIMD instructions ran; five not naturally aligned accesses (2 vector, 3 ldr x in memmove) all hit Normal write-back pages with SCTLR.A = 0. The model has no caches, TLB, exceptions or timers and builds boot_args and the ADT as loader.c does; behaviour of the S24 past assembly checkpoint 5 remains unknown.
